spc_xbar_r — SPC chart op

• Data kinds: matrix → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.spc_xbar_r(subgroups) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import spc; spc.spc_xbar_r(subgroups), registry से लेना हो तो opsspc.get("spc_xbar_r"))

उपयोग

subgroup measurements से Shewhart Xbar-R control chart।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

subgroups is a 2-D array of shape (m, n) — m subgroups of n measurements each, 2 <= n <= 10 (the range chart is only calibrated for small subgroups). For each subgroup j the plotted statistics are the mean Xbar_j and the range R_j = max - min. The centre lines are the grand mean Xbarbar and the mean range Rbar, and with the ISO 8258 constants (A2, D3, D4) for that n::

xbar_ucl = Xbarbar + A2*Rbar xbar_lcl = Xbarbar - A2*Rbar

r_ucl = D4*Rbar r_lcl = D3*Rbar

Returns a dict (a "table") with the per-subgroup xbar / r arrays, the six limits and three centre lines, the integer indices out_of_control of subgroups outside either chart, and in_control (True when that list is empty). The constants are fixed by n: for n=5 they are exactly A2=0.577, D3=0.000, D4=2.115 (pinned in the tests).

Raises ValueError: a non-2-D / empty *subgroups*, a subgroup size outside [2, 10], or non-finite / mislabelled input.
